caption: The drawing depicts a classroom interior with light green walls and a wooden floor. Along the back wall are two doors labeled "BOYS" on the left and "GIRLS" on the right, each leading to small cloakrooms filled with hats, coats, and boots. In the center back wall, there is a black chalkboard with white writing and two drawn overlapping hearts. Above the chalkboard hang two framed portraits—one of a man and one of a woman—and an American flag draped between them. Red, white, and blue streamers crisscross the ceiling. Desks made of dark brown wood with black metal legs are arranged in four rows, each with books, papers, and some colored drawings on top. Some desks have red apples, pencils, and open notebooks. At the front of the room, a wooden teacher’s desk holds more books and supplies, facing the students. On the left side near the front is a round metal stove with a pipe extending up and across the ceiling. A globe sits on one desk at the left, and there is a small wastebasket near the teacher’s desk. Gas lamps with glass shades are mounted on the right wall, beside a window with green trim. A red bucket and other cleaning supplies are on a shelf below the lamps. The windows show a snowy landscape outside.
title: Rural School Room, 1900
